title: DND seeks NBI probe into alleged fake Teodoro letter on Ayungin operation
summary: The Department of National Defense said it sought the assistance of the National Bureau of Investigation over an alleged fabricated letter supposedly signed by Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr.…

blocks.text: The Department of National Defense said it sought the assistance of the National Bureau of Investigation over an alleged fabricated letter supposedly signed by Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. regarding an operation at Ayungin Shoal and the Philippines' cooperation with the US.

why: headline only by design — this outlet blocks article pages
